Dive into our collection of past corporate gatherings held at The Makoy. Visualize the high-tech facilities, superior ambiance, and unparalleled guest experience that we deliver time and again. Our commitment to providing exceptional service is not just our claim but is validated by the industry awards we have won and the words of praise from our satisfied clientele. Discover why businesses across Ohio choose The Makoy as their trusted partner for all
